name: Celeste
description: Climb the mountain with company. CelesteNet adds online play to Celeste through the Everest mod loader: you see other players on the same map, can chat with them, and meet them in the lobbies of a CelesteNet server.

setup.title: Celeste
setup.detail: Install Celeste from your Steam library.

setup.title: Everest installed
setup.detail: Install the Everest mod loader once with Olympus (everestapi.github.io), then come back here.
Download the mod above: Cairn puts it in the game's Mods folder.

hostSteps: Install the Everest mod loader once with Olympus (it is a free, separate tool). Cairn does not change the game's own files.
Download the mod above. Cairn puts it in the game's Mods folder and keeps it up to date.
Press Play and open CelesteNet from the main menu. Connect to the public CelesteNet server, or to your own: run the CelesteNet server and share its address.
joinSteps: Install the Everest mod loader once with Olympus, then download the mod above.
Press Play and open CelesteNet from the main menu.
Connect to the same server as your friends: you see each other on the same map.

items.name: Connect to a server
items.detail: Players meet on a CelesteNet server: the public one or a server you run yourself. Everyone needs the same version of the mod.

items.name: Kept up to date
items.detail: Cairn installs the mod in the game's Mods folder and updates it when a new version is released.

items.name: Other players
items.detail: Players on the same map are shown as ghosts, with their names.

items.name: Chat
items.detail: Text chat between the players of a server.
